extDescription.message: Sends browser downloads, links and video streams to Vibe Download Manager.

menuDownload.description: Context menu entry on links, images, video and audio.

popupChecking.description: Shown while the popup asks the app whether it is running.

popupNotFound.message: Vibe Download Manager not found. Install it and run $1.
popupNotFound.description: $1 is a command shown as code: vdm-nmhost install.

popupVideos.description: Heading of the list of detected video streams.

popupNoStreams.message: No video streams detected yet. Start playing the video.
popupNoStreams.description: Shown when the page has no detected streams.

popupCapture.description: Checkbox: hand the browser's downloads to the app.

popupLastError.description: $1 is a date and time, $2 the error message.

popupDownloadStream.description: Button next to a detected video stream.

popupSending.description: Shown while a stream is handed to the app.

popupSent.description: The stream was handed to the app.

popupSendFailed.description: Handing the stream to the app failed.

errUnexpectedReply.message: Vibe Download Manager sent an unexpected reply
errUnexpectedReply.description: Error when the app answers with something unexpected.

errHttpLinksOnly.message: Only http(s) links can be sent to Vibe
errHttpLinksOnly.description: Error for links with other schemes.

errHttpStreamsOnly.message: Only http(s) streams can be sent to Vibe
errHttpStreamsOnly.description: Error for streams with other schemes.
